title: Statement Notes on the Payment Share in Penalty Relief
content:
**Note.** On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, the full penalty paid in a penalty relief request is multiplied by a payment share. The payment share follows the contributions of the quarter being relieved:

| Contributions of the relieved quarter | Payment share |
|---|---|
| Assessed and not yet fully covered by the payments and credits applied to them | 0.8 |
| Fully covered, with the last contribution payment after the report's due date | 0.9 |
| Fully covered by the due date | 1 |

**Terms used.**

- *Contributions assessed* — every contribution assessment booked for the quarter, added together.
- *Covered* — the contribution payments and the contribution credits booked for the quarter, added together, reach the contributions assessed.
- *Last contribution payment* — the contribution payment for the quarter with the latest entry date.
- *The report's due date* — the due date of the quarter's original report, the one with the latest filing date for that quarter.

## Hypothetical quarters (contributions assessed USD 1,200.00, report due 31 July)

| Payments and credits applied to contributions | Last contribution payment | Covered | Payment share |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 1,000.00 of payments | 25 July | No | 0.8 |
| USD 1,100.00 of payments and a USD 100.00 credit | 12 August | Yes | 0.9 |
| USD 1,200.00 of payments | 31 July | Yes | 1 |
| USD 1,200.00 of payments | 1 August | Yes | 0.9 |

A payment on the due date itself, 31 July, is not after the due date; a payment on 1 August is.
